MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Sammle Praxiserfahrung in Operations & digitalen Prozessen – mitten im operativen Tagesgeschäft
 
Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Business Administration, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen endlich in der Praxis anwenden? Du interessierst dich für digitale Anwendungen, Daten und operative Prozesse, arbeitest strukturiert und sorgfältig und möchtest Teil eines motivierten Teams werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team im Bereich Order Management, Rollout und Service Delivery im operativen Tagesgeschäft. Dabei erhältst du spannende Einblicke in Auftrags- und Serviceprozesse, arbeitest mit verschiedenen Systemen und unterstützt dabei, Datenqualität und operative Abläufe zuverlässig sicherzustellen.
 
 
Das erwartet dich
 
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team bei der administrativen Bearbeitung und Koordination von Aufträgen und Servicevorgängen. Du übernimmst klar definierte Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft, arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Systemen und Schnittstellen und unterstützt bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer operativen Abläufe.
 
Unter anderem unterstützt du bei:
 

  • Erfassung, Pflege und Aktualisierung von Auftrags-, Kunden- und Servicedaten in den relevanten Systemen
  • Prüfung eingehender Aufträge und Vorgänge auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und Datenqualität
  • Übertragung, Abgleich und Pflege von Informationen zwischen unterschiedlichen Systemen und Prozessschritten
  • Nachhalten fehlender Informationen sowie Klärung von Rückfragen mit internen Schnittstellen
  • Unterstützung bei der administrativen Abwicklung und Koordination von Aufträgen im Ordermanagement, Rollout und Service Delivery
  • Bearbeitung und Dokumentation definierter Kunden- und Servicevorgänge sowie Unterstützung bei der Ticketbearbeitung
  • Erkennen und Dokumentieren wiederkehrender Fehler, Datenabweichungen und manueller Prozesshindernisse
  • Unterstützung bei Datenbereinigungen, Prozessdokumentationen und Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Datenqualität und operativen Abläufe
 
Das bringst du mit
 
  • Laufendes Studium der BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Business Administration, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Hohe Affinität zu digitalen Anwendungen und Systemen sowie idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit CRM-, ERP- oder Ticketsystemen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie analytisches Denken und ein ausgeprägtes Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Teamgeist, Kommunikationsstärke und Lernbereitschaft sowie Freude daran, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Verbesserungspotenziale zu erkennen
Berufserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und dein Interesse an digitalen Prozessen.
 
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche, passend zu deinem Studium
  • Freie Verteilung deiner Arbeitszeit – zum Beispiel zwei volle Tage und ein halber Tag oder ganz nach Absprache
  • Praktische Einblicke in operative Auftrags- und Serviceprozesse
  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten
  • Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie persönliche Betreuung
 
Deine Entwicklung
 
  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in das Ordermanagement sowie in Rollout- und Service-Delivery-Prozesse
  • Aufbau von Kenntnissen im Umgang mit CRM-, ERP- und Ticketsystemen
  • Entwicklung eines fundierten Verständnisses für Datenqualität und operative Prozessabläufe
  • Mitarbeit an Datenbereinigungen, Prozessdokumentationen und Optimierungsmaßnahmen
  • Übernahme eigener klar definierter Aufgaben und Arbeitspakete
  • Wertvolle Berufserfahrung für deinen weiteren Karriereweg
 
Arbeiten bei ecotel
 
  • Duz-Kultur auf allen Ebenen
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Karneval
  • Modern ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze
  • Firmenlaptop und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fitnessraum am Standort Düsseldorf
  • Kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst
  • Kostenfreie Parkplätze in unserer Tiefgarage
  • Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung
  • 30 Urlaubstage (5-Tage-Woche) sowie bezahlter Sonderurlaub bei besonderen persönlichen Ereignissen
  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
 
Attraktive Vergütung
 
  • 1.350 € brutto pro Monat bei einer 20-Stunden-Woche  
 
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
 
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 
Bitte sende uns folgende Unterlagen:
 
  • deinen Lebenslauf
  • deine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  • optional ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem wir erfahren, warum du unser Team unterstützen möchtest
 
Vielfalt ist für uns selbstverständlich. Alter, Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Religion oder eine Behinderung spielen für uns keine Rolle – wir freuen uns auf Menschen mit Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Begeisterung für Digitalisierung.
 
Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – #readyfordigitalbusiness.
 
Dein Ansprechpartner: Dominic Schillers

data.description:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

ABOUT US:

Impossible Cloud is a fast-growing B2B cloud company headquartered in Hamburg, Germany. We have built a cloud object storage solution comparable to AWS S3, purpose-built and optimised for AI and compute workloads. Our commercial hyper-growth speaks for itself, powered by our channel-first go-to-market strategy.

We are now expanding beyond storage: we are building a high-performance compute platform, offering an end-to-end solution from GPU infrastructure to full GPU platform software stack. In doing so, we are redefining the cloud ecosystem by bridging the gap between decentralised infrastructure (DePIN), mainstream B2B cloud use cases, and AI applications.

 

Find out more about us here.

 

Please note that we can only consider candidates who have a valid, unrestricted work permit for the EU.


Your Impact

Impossible Cloud has extended its European cloud platform with managed inference, and the first commercial conversations are happening now. This role owns the DACH market for it. You find the AI-native companies, software vendors and enterprises that need production inference with European data residency, and you take them from first conversation to signed contract.


WHAT YOU WILL DO:
  • Own the DACH market for managed inference with personal revenue accountability, from first outreach to signed contract.
  • Build your own pipeline among AI-native companies, software vendors and enterprises that run or plan production AI workloads, and qualify every opportunity against real budget and timeline.
  • Run technical buying cycles with CTOs, ML and platform leads and procurement, and make data sovereignty and EU residency a concrete buying criterion in regulated and compliance-driven accounts.
  • Work with Solutions Engineering to scope proofs of concept and convert them into production commitments with clear pricing and terms.
  • Bring partners such as integrators, ISVs and resellers into deals where they add reach, and run partner-led motions where that is the faster path to close.
  • Feed insight from won and lost deals back to Product and Marketing so the offer reflects what DACH buyers actually ask for.

    • WHAT YOU BRING:
  • A verifiable track record of hitting and exceeding quota in complex B2B technology sales, ideally in cloud, AI infrastructure or developer platforms, plus an existing network of technical and executive buyers in DACH. We will ask for specifics, not summaries.
  • Enough technical depth to hold your own with ML engineers on model serving, latency, throughput and token-based pricing, and to explain what they mean commercially.
  • You have owned hard problems end to end as the person who figured it out, for example opening a new product category or market without an existing playbook.
  • You hold yourself and the people around you to a high standard, and colleagues you have worked with would hire you again.
  • Professional proficiency in German and English.
  • AI-native working style: you use AI tools to move faster and work smarter. This is a baseline expectation at Impossible Cloud, not a differentiator.

    • WHAT WE OFFER:

    • Competitive salary coupled with direct engagement in your success through an enticing ESOP.
    • Clear and transparent career progression scheme inspired by the best performing organisations incl. fast track promotion opportunity for exceptional performance to support your growth ambitions.
    • Prime growth-stage company with proven revenue and a sharp edge in cloud — founded by serial entrepreneurs with multiple successful exits.
    • Experienced, passionate team working with cutting-edge cloud technology.
    • A vibrant office in a trendy location with free brain food and a canteen — plus a subsidized premium gym membership and monthly team meet-ups that bring the whole crew together!
     

    OUR CULTURE:

    We are committed to success. We embrace individuals from all backgrounds who share the goal of building a future European cloud champion, celebrated through a richly diverse team of 15+ nationalities and 10+ languages spoken.

     

    OUR HIRING PROCESS:

    Apply: Submit your CV or LinkedIn profile via the application form.

    First response: We review every application carefully and get back to you within a few days. If your profile is a strong match, we'll invite you to an intro call via Google Meet.

    Get to know us: We move quickly through two to four interview steps, including a meeting with our founders.

    Offer: If it's a mutual fit, you'll receive a personal offer and feedback call, followed by a written offer document.

We are seeking a Procurement Manager to lead sourcing, supplier management, and purchasing operations while ensuring a reliable, cost-effective supply of materials that supports production, inventory, and business growth.

This role develops and executes procurement strategies, manages supplier performance, partners cross-functionally to support production requirements, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that optimize inventory, reduce costs, and strengthen supply chain performance.

About us

Join bonify, Germany’s leading platform for credit scoring and financial management. We are on the mission to revolutionize the FinTech industry and make the credit score and financial data available and transparent for our users.

We are hiring a Senior Product Designer (part-time, 32hrs/week) to shape how millions of users understand and improve their financial health across mobile and web.

You'll own design end-to-end for a defined product area, from framing the right problems through research, prototyping, validation, and delivery. Our focus is on creating more value beyond the credit score, making complex financial information feel simple, useful, and trustworthy, and embedding AI into both our products and our daily work.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a strong research mindset. You'll speak directly with German-speaking users, work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data, contribute to our design system, and support less experienced designers through collaboration and feedback.

Your tasks

  • Lead product design for a defined area across mobile and web.
  • Turn complex financial and credit-related information into experiences that feel simple, useful and trustworthy.
  • Plan and conduct customer research, interviews and usability testing, particularly with German-speaking users.
  • Translate qualitative research and behavioural data into clear product decisions.

Über die Position

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus

Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche.

Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei June

Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO.

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.

Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen.

Anforderungen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten.
  • Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)
  • Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools.
  • Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs).
  • AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst.
  • Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.
  • Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung.

Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.
  • Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst.
  • Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.
  • Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich.
  • Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June.

So arbeiten wir

Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs.
Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.
Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht.
Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release.

Die Perspektive

Was dich erwartet

  • Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen.
  • Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern
  • Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite.
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap.
  • Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess.
  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort.

Hinweis: Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

data.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations: Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain, with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we are bolting on, it is central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we are heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations.

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes.

Who You Are

You are studying for a master's degree and want to see how a remote-first technology company really runs day to day. You like variety: one day might be a customer's supplier questionnaire, the next a recurring task you're automating with Claude. You enjoy working out how a process works and then making it better.

You work independently and in a structured way, and you're comfortable asking questions and working with Security, Legal and Finance to get something done. You care about the details, because supplier registrations and internal records need to be right. You're curious about AI and automation tools, and you want to use them on real work instead of just reading about them.

If you meet most of the qualifications below and the role interests you, apply. Curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more to us than a perfect match.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a working student to support our Operations and Financial Management department. The focus of this role is supporting the supplier registrations requested by our customers and helping us build and improve AI-supported workflows across the department. Your responsibilities include, among others:

  • Supporting the registration of Develocity as a supplier in our customers' procurement portals, including completing recurring questionnaires and gathering supporting evidence, in coordination with the Security, Legal, and Finance teams.
  • Learning our supplier registration process in depth, helping to implement improvements, and keeping the guides and training material up to date.
  • Building, testing, and improving AI-supported workflows with Claude, as well as with common automation tools, to reduce recurring manual work.
  • Helping to introduce new software tools, including writing short guides and answering questions from the teams.
  • Assisting our Business Administration team with recurring administrative tasks and keeping our internal records and systems up to date.
  • Supporting our Finance teams from time to time.
  • Taking on other tasks across the department as they come up, which lets you get to know several areas over time.

Minimum qualifications

  • Enrolment in a master's program, for example in business administration, business informatics, financial controlling, or a comparable field.
  • Basic understanding of business administration, attention to detail, and analytical thinking.
  • Flexibility and an open mind, as the role combines very different tasks from several teams.
  • An interest in improving current systems and processes, and you enjoy working with automation and AI tools such as Claude Code.
  • An independent, focused, and structured way of working, along with a collaborative mindset and good communication skills.
  • German at C2 or native level, English at B2 level or higher.

What We Offer

  • An immediate start, with weekly hours agreed individually around your studies.
  • A dynamic working environment in a Silicon Valley company with flat hierarchies and plenty of room for initiative and development.
  • Work at an international, fast-moving technology leader.
  • Onboarding and guidance from experienced colleagues.
  • In-person meetings, such as regular department and company meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • A diverse and inclusive environment in which we learn from one another. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences, skills and perspectives.

Location

  • Remote from anywhere in Germany.
  • Our headquarters is in San Francisco, and our teams work remotely across locations, which allows for a high degree of flexibility, collaboration and creativity. The Operations and Financial Management department is led from the Saarbrücken area in Germany and is responsible for the entire group.
  • While we work remotely, with everything in place for seamless collaboration by email, chat and video call, we deeply value in-person time and meet regularly as a department and as a company.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

  • Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

  • Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

  • Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

About You

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

  • You can do 2 or more of the following:

  • Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

  • Develop and deploy NLP solutions

  • Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

  • Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

  • You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

  • You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

  • You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

  • You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

Compensation

Über DrAnsay

DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.

Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.

Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.

Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.

Was du konkret machst

  • Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

  • OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

  • Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

  • Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

  • User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

  • Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

  • Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

  • Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren



Das brauchst du

  • Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

  • Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

  • Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

  • Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

Das fällt positiv auf

  • Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

  • Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

  • Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

  • Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

  • Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

  • Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

  • Erfahrung in stark regulierten Produktumfeldern

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit UX-Teams und der Einbindung von User Research

Was wir bieten

  • Vollzeit und unbefristet, Start ab November 2026

  • 100% Remote: Du arbeitest aus Deutschland, Vollzeit, ohne Standortbindung

  • Eine Rolle, die mitwächst: Je tiefer dein Verständnis von Produkten, Markt und Team, desto mehr Entscheidungen übernimmst du

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CPO und Zeit, alle Produktbereiche gründlich kennenzulernen

  • Sichtbare Wirkung: Du prägst, wie DrAnsay neue Produkte startet und woran das Product-Team arbeitet

  • Kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, Low-Ego-Kultur und direktem Feedback

  • Ein Produkt mit realem Nutzen: Wir helfen täglich Menschen, Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher zu bekommen

Wie du dich bewirbst

Bewirb dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular. Kein Anschreiben erforderlich, wir stellen dir einige kurze Fragen, die uns helfen zu verstehen, wie du arbeitest. Diese Antworten sind uns wichtiger als dein LinkedIn-Profil.

Du hörst von uns innerhalb von fünf Arbeitstagen.

DrAnsay ist ein chancengleicher Arbeitgeber. Bewerbungen werden auf Basis von Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung bewertet. Alle Bewerbenden werden unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion oder anderen geschützten Merkmalen berücksichtigt. DrAnsay verarbeitet die mit deiner Bewerbung übermittelten personenbezogenen Daten zur Durchführung des Recruitingprozesses.

Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
  • Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
  • Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
  • Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family  an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
  • Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
  • Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
  • Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.


Your Application

What we do

AI is redefining how companies compete. Most organizations know they need to transform but only few know how to realize it. As AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you are the person who bridges that gap: turning strategic ambition into lasting organizational change.

Merantix Momentum is developing the next generation of impact-driven AI. As a Berlin-based startup, we are driving enterprise AI transformations across industries by building and deploying B2B solutions, orchestrating scaled, AI-native operations. We work across several domains including automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and others, transforming businesses through ML using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning. Our start-up DNA defines the way we drive rapid value creation with a humble, diverse, and hungry team.


Your role

As an AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you bring deep domain and consulting experience to lead clients through end-to-end AI transformation, from identifying strategic opportunities to driving organizational and technical change at scale. You are equally comfortable leading a focused 6-week engagement with a 500-person Mittelstand manufacturer as well as a multi-phase transformation with a large enterprise. You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives.

You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum’s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals.

Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. You are fluent in modern AI trends and applied technology and you can educate, challenge, and influence stakeholders with credibility and confidence.

You don't just advise on AI: you understand how it truly works. You are fluent in modern AI capabilities and can explain how AI capabilities, products, and bespoke Machine Learning solutions are built. This allows you to credibly champion solutions, evaluate investment choices, navigate technical trade-offs, and convince key stakeholders of AI's transformative value.

Your main responsibilities will include the following:

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer the end-to-end execution of AI transformation engagements — from first lighthouse use case to company-wide rollout. Find the internal champions, manage the blockers, build multi-threaded stakeholder relationships, and drive measurable adoption and organizational change.

  • Support Key Account Growth: Convert pipeline opportunities into growing account relationships and multi-layered transformation programs with the Sales team; support pre-sales, proposal writing, and key-account expansion with an entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Merantix Momentum's opinion on AI transformation by inspiring and challenging stakeholders with opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends, real-world adoption pathways, and what it actually takes to move from pilot to scale.

  • Advance the AI Transformation practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art and to develop reusable transformation playbooks, bringing in consulting or domain expertise into the team.

  • Enable Colleagues: Advise colleagues on AI transformation best practices by leading project teams, sharing lessons learned, and contributing to a fast-paced, can-do culture.

When applying please include a cover letter explaining your fit and motivation for this role as AI Transformation Manager.


Your profile

At our heart, we remain a startup and define ourselves by a culture of ownership and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable, and prudent talents with a strong motivation and hunger for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow.

  • You are a team player and willing to learn, support and grow in a team and as a company.

  • Preferably 8+ years of full-time working experience in management consulting, enterprise technology, AI/ML-driven companies, or other fast-paced environments like leading startups and boutique consulting firms.

  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs with the ability to manage executive stakeholders and drive organizational change.

  • Strong fluency in advising on AI, orchestrating its build, operating a model allowing organizations to scale AI, and enabling management to make the right investments.

  • Knowledgeable about common machine learning techniques and trends; experience in AI use case conceptualization and assessing technical feasibility.

  • Demonstrated experience in change management and embedding AI capabilities within client organizations.

  • Curiosity to constantly explore and learn about new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business.

  • Great communication skills in German and English.


What we offer

You will become part of a highly capable and motivated team driven by a joint mission and eager to learn and grow with and from each other. We are an international and diverse team always supporting and challenging each other to get out the best in each of us. Become part of the entire Merantix ecosystem at the AI Campus in Berlin and join us on transforming the European AI landscape.

  • Engaging Topics and Excellence: Merantix offers unique insights into applied machine learning research and development, working with a group of highly talented engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs

  • Dynamic working culture: We hold weekly and monthly events around AI Innovation and Implementation. We have a flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours. We have a flexible work-from-home policy but you are very welcome to work from our office situated on the AI Campus in Berlin.

  • Learning and Development: Individual learning and development budget to attend conferences or purchase educational resources to further develop additional skills. Extra amount of vacation for Learning and Development.

  • Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software.

  • Hardware allowance: We give you support to have all the equipment you would need to thrive on your job.

  • Sabbatical Leave.

  • Add-ons: We offer 50€ per employee per month that can be allocated as desired to one of the following: Mobility & transportation (NAVIT), Sport (Urban Sports Club membership) or groceries (Edenred).

We're digitizing the construction industry – are you in?

At VESTIGAS, you build the digital backbone of the construction supply chain. We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field – not just in theory.


Your Role

You'll help build the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform, working across the full lifecycle – from pipeline design to production deployment. With 5+ years of experience under your belt, you're ready for the next step in your career. Maybe you've already mentored or technically guided colleagues, and you're looking to grow steadily into a Team Lead role as you take on more ownership and, over time, people responsibility.

The Technical ChallengeYou'll work on problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough". This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents you've never seen before, and where every accuracy gain has a direct, visible impact on our customers' daily operations.


Your Mission

  • Lead MLOps processes and maintain infrastructure to keep our AI systems reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Design and implement advanced AI features, working closely with engineering and product teams to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Improve the accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of existing AI features through rigorous testing
  • Contribute to the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and help build new ones from scratch
  • Align your technical work with customer needs and support product and sales discussions
  • Help establish engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices
  • Mentor and technically guide colleagues as you build the track record to grow into a leadership role
  • Use modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor as part of your daily workflow


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • 5+ years of experience in AI engineering, including end-to-end lifecycle management and MLOps
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Ideally, some experience mentoring or technically guiding others – and the ambition to grow into a Chapter Lead role
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.

We turn purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices into a digital, legally compliant platform used in everyday operations by construction companies and suppliers. You’ll work on a product with real market traction in the DACH mid-market, ship iteratively, and take ownership of solutions that must work in the field – not just in theory.


Your Role

As Chapter Lead AI Engineering, you'll own the AI infrastructure and capabilities that power our supply chain platform end to end – from pipeline design to production deployment. You bring experience in technical leadership and take responsibility for the AI engineering chapter across Scrum teams, shaping architecture, aligning technical standards, and enabling engineers to build dependable AI systems. This is a hands-on technical leadership role.

The Technical ChallengeYour chapter will tackle problems like extracting structured data reliably from many different documents, building uncertainty estimation so the system knows when to flag a document for human review instead of silently guessing, and automatically reconciling purchase orders, delivery notes, and invoices against each other – all within legal and compliance requirements that leave no room for "close enough". This is a domain where clean benchmark metrics mean far less than robustness against real documents nobody has seen before – and you'll set the technical direction for how the chapter navigates that trade-off, deciding where to push automation further and where human review still matters. Agentic AI systems that plan, use tools, and act on their own are an increasingly important part of this work as well.


Your Mission

  • Provide technical leadership for the AI engineering chapter, own its technical direction and strengthen shared engineering practices across Scrum teams
  • Own MLOps processes and infrastructure, ensuring our AI systems are reliable, scalable, and secure
  • Drive the design and implementation of advanced AI features, partner closely with engineering and product leadership to deploy machine learning models and data pipelines
  • Set the bar for accuracy, efficiency, and uncertainty estimation of our AI features through rigorous testing practices
  • Ensure the scalability, maintainability, and core functionality of our AI solutions – and drive the build of new ones from scratch
  • Translate customer needs into technical priorities and represent AI engineering in strategic product and sales discussions
  • Establish and evolve engineering standards, tooling, and quality practices across the chapter
  • Mentor fellow AI engineers through technical feedback, pairing, and knowledge sharing
  • Champion the use of modern AI tools such as Claude or Cursor across the chapter


Your Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; alternatively, an equivalent education
  • You have at least five years of AI engineering experience, including one year of technical leadership, with practical responsibility spanning the AI lifecycle and MLOps
  • Demonstrated ownership of technical decisions, with the ability to align engineers across teams and mentor peers
  • Hands-on expertise in natural language processing and image processing
  • Strong Python skills and experience with Azure; Terraform experience is a plus
  • A passion for generative AI, OCR, and building customer-focused solutions
  • A habit of writing clean, well-tested code with an eye on what happens after deployment
  • Solid understanding of AI agents, tools, and their limitations
  • Fluent English and German (C1 or above)
  • Willingness to work from our Munich office at least two days a week


Your Benefits

  • Real ownership instead of micromanagement. You shape, you decide, and you see the impact of your work directly in the market.
  • Direct line to founders and leadership. Flat hierarchies are our everyday reality – short paths, fast decisions.
  • AI-First workflow. Copilot, Claude, Cursor & co. are standard tools for us. We expect and support their use.
  • Hybrid work with an office in the heart of Munich, just around the corner from Theresienwiese. Flexible setup with regular office presence – because we believe the best ideas happen in person.
  • EGYM Wellpass or BahnCard, corporate benefits, team events, annual offsites.
  • Fair, competitive compensation.

Wir digitalisieren die Bauindustrie. Bist du dabei?

Bei VESTIGAS baust du an der digitalen Grundlage der Bau-Lieferkette: Wir machen aus Bestellungen, Lieferscheinen und Rechnungen eine digitale, rechtssichere Plattform, die im Alltag von Bauunternehmen und Lieferanten genutzt wird. Du arbeitest an einem Produkt mit echter Marktdurchdringung in einem riesigen DACH-Mittelstandsmarkt, lieferst Ergebnisse iterativ und übernimmst Ownership für Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren müssen und nicht nur im Konzept.


Deine Rolle

Als Account Executive (w/m/d) bei VESTIGAS verantwortest du qualifizierte Leads über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg – von der ersten Präsentation unserer Lösung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Je nach Erfahrung, Dealgröße und Komplexität führst du eigenständig schnelle Abschlüsse oder steuerst anspruchsvollere Sales-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Sales oder den Foundern.

  • Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss übergibst du strukturiert an Customer Success, damit der Start für neue Kund:innen reibungslos verläuft.

Deine Aufgaben

Durch ein stetig wachsendes DAM-Produkt, eine anspruchsvolle Zielgruppe aus Marketingverantwortlichen, steigende Anforderungen an unsere IT- und Entwicklungslandschaft sowie ambitionierte Unternehmensziele bauen wir unsere Produktorganisation weiter aus. Als Senior Product Manager B2B (d/w/m*) arbeitest du in unseren neu formierten, agilen, crossfunktionalen Domain-Teams und verantwortest eigenständig deine Produktfeatures: von der Identifikation relevanter Kundenprobleme über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Wirkung am Markt und mit Direct Report zum CEO.

Im Detail bedeutet dies:

  • Produkt- & Domain-Verantwortung: Du verantwortest Strategie, Prioritäten und Outcomes für deinen Bereich und steuerst Kennzahlen wie Nutzung, Engagement, Retention, Kundenzufriedenheit und Umsatz.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht:
  • Klare End-to-End-Verantwortung statt Feature-Abarbeitung,
  • starke Kundennähe als zentraler Erfolgsfaktor,
  • hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Entscheidungskompetenz,
  • Fokus auf Wirkung, nicht auf Output.


Dein Profil

Unser Team ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Deshalb suchen wir eine erfahrene Person im Produktmanagement, die Kundennähe mit Klarheit, Entscheidungsstärke und einem hohen Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein verbindet. Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit:

The ambition is to build a best-in-class fraud platform: one that performs at the highest level, adapts as fraud changes and works equally well for merchants as it does to protect Checkout. Protecting Checkout from fraud has significant value for the overall payment performance,

This is a portfolio leadership role. You will lead several Product Managers, co-own the Fraud Data Science roadmap and work closely with Engineering, Analytics, Fraud Operations and Design. You will also spend time with some of the world’s most sophisticated merchants to understand their fraud challenges, prove value and shape what we build next.

Set the fraud strategy

  • Decide where we need to close core gaps and where we can build differentiated capabilities that change the basis of competition.

  • Improve the performance, coverage and resilience of our real-time fraud decisioning.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare, you’ll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run.

In regulated industries, relationships are the currency, so we’re looking for a leader who already knows the buyers and the rulebook. You’ll have the mandate to win net-new logos, drive agent sales, and build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive adoption of ElevenLabs, including closing deals yourself and also building and scaling the team

  • Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

  • Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

  • Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

  • Open doors through your own network of senior buyers, and turn early wins into the references the rest of the vertical will call

  • Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

  • Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

  • Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

  • Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

  • Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

  • Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

  • Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience, including at least 2 years leading a team.

  • Track record selling into health systems, payers, or life sciences, with deep fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, AI governance, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • An established network of senior decision-makers in one or more of health systems, payers, or life sciences, so you can name the buyers you’d call in your first 30 days

  • Experience building a new sales motion or playbook from scratch, whether as a founding leader or inside a larger company

  • Passion for experimenting to find the positioning and messaging that wins in market, and turn what works into the playbook

  • Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

  • Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

  • Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

  • Low ego and hands-on: equally at home in a C-suite briefing and in the weeds of a prospecting list or Proof of Value. Motivated by impact and growth more than title

  • Passion for the transformative potential of voice and conversational AI

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points

  • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

  • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

  • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

Location

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.


Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
