L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. 1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing & Events

  • Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription

  • Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas

  • Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée

  • Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA

  • Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com

  • Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister

  • Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence

    • 2. Mesurer, analyser, arbitrer

    Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

  • Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions

  • Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne

  • Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater

  • Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing & Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

    • 3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel

    L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.

  • Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA

  • Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

    • L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.


    La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰

    Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.

  • LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini

  • Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen

  • Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster

  • Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI

  • Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes

    • Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.


    Le profil que nous recherchons 🌟

  • Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat

  • Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.

  • Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire

  • Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie

  • Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté

  • Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien

data.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Who are we?

moka.care is a mental health solution for companies, with one mission in mind: nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations.

We guide employees through individual and group therapy or coaching sessions.

Alongside we help HR teams to take care of their employees’ mental health on a daily basis.

Where we are currently: Since our creation in December 2019, more than 400 companies (L'Oreal, Spendesk, Qonto, Engie, Castalie, etc.) have joined moka.care, and we now have over 300,000 employees covered in France but also throughout the world!

We have raised 17,5 million euros and are 70 to help companies improve their mental well-being.

What we believe in? Excellence in care is our obsession.

Culture is not nice words we put on the walls, we have defined 4 tangible values to make this culture live: Team Play, Optimism, Ownership & Agility.


Why do we need you?

Moka.Care has built strong foundations in a rapidly evolving market. We are now looking for a marketing leader who can scale our growth and pipeline generation efforts, strengthen our commercial execution, improve go-to-market effectiveness and continue building a leading brand for HR and People teams.

Reporting to Guillaume d’Ayguesvives, co-founder, you will own Moka.Care’s global marketing strategy with a strong focus on pipeline generation, revenue impact and commercial performance.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of 8 people organized across three main areas:

  • Brand, Awareness & Customer Enablement, led by a Brand & Product Marketing Lead
  • Lead Generation, Content & Sales Enablement
  • BDR Team, led by a BDR Team Lead

You will also work closely with the Revenue Operations team to ensure strong alignment between marketing performance, pipeline generation and revenue outcomes.

This role is designed for a performance-oriented marketing leader who combines strategic vision with operational excellence, and who knows how to build scalable growth systems in B2B environments.

What will you do?

Lead a high-performing marketing organization

  • Provide clear direction, prioritization and performance management across the team
  • Coach and develop managers and senior contributors
  • Stay closely involved in execution, funnel performance and operational priorities
  • Strengthen collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Customer, Product, Tech and Revenue Operations teams

Lead Moka.Care’s growth and pipeline generation

  • Define Moka.Care’s growth and lead generation priorities across inbound, outbound, paid acquisition and lifecycle marketing
  • Scale a predictable and efficient pipeline generation engine aligned with revenue objectives
  • Improve acquisition efficiency, funnel conversion and channel performance
  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to strengthen marketing performance measurement, attribution and budget allocation decisions
  • Strengthen alignment and operating rhythms between Marketing, BDR and Sales teams
  • Lead and develop the BDR Team Lead to maximize outbound pipeline generation and performance

Drive commercial positioning & go-to-market effectiveness

  • Partner closely with Brand & Product Marketing Lead to ensure Moka.Care’s positioning and messaging effectively support pipeline generation and revenue objectives
  • Improve go-to-market effectiveness by strengthening the connection between marketing initiatives, commercial priorities and sales execution
  • Guide segmentation, market expansion and strategic growth initiatives
  • Ensure strong alignment between positioning, messaging and commercial strategy
  • Contribute to maximizing the commercial impact of new offers, campaigns and strategic initiatives

Act as a strategic thinking partner to our Brand & Product Marketing Lead to

  • Support thought leadership through public-facing opportunities and by building relationships with key influencers (HR leaders, scientific experts, industry communities, etc.)
  • Support brand awareness initiatives with creative campaign ideas and strong narratives
  • Protect consistency across brand, content and communication initiatives

You’re the ideal person if

  • You have 8+ years of experience in B2B marketing, including leadership roles (ideally marketing to HR and People Teams as core target personas)
  • You have a strong track record in demand generation, pipeline creation and revenue-focused marketing
  • You have experience leading or working closely with BDR/SDR teams and outbound pipeline generation
  • You are highly data-driven and comfortable working closely with funnel performance and GTM metrics
  • You combine strategic thinking with a strong operational mindset
  • You also have a strong brand sensibility and understand the importance of positioning and messaging
  • You know how to build strong alignment between Marketing, BDR, Sales and Revenue Operations teams
  • You are fluent in both French and English

Joining us you will

  • Participate in an entrepreneurial fast-growing adventure and the possibility of having a huge potential for evolution inside moka
  • See the concrete impact of your efforts each day and participate in nurturing healthy minds to foster healthy organizations
  • Grow as a person and learn within a team of great people
  • Be trusted: we hire great talents who lead us to the next level

We'll take care of you

  • Access to Moka.Care: selfcare, individual & group sessions, and the possibility to test the new features in preview
  • Benefit Fund - May : up to 1500€ net / year (125€ net / month)
  • BSPCE for everyone
  • Work life balance: 60% at the office - 2 days per week or 1 week per month remotely
  • Swile Meal voucher card of 10€/day (restaurants, groceries and food apps)
  • Gymlib for sport & wellness allowance
  • Transportation allowance (50% reimbursed)
  • 7 week holiday policy (& one additional day off per year)

Interview Process

  • Phone interview 
  • Background Interview
  • A Case study and job focused interview to project yourself in your future day-to-day job
  • And finally a Value fit interview to make sure you’ll feel comfortable at moka

If needed we organize other informal talks like coffee with the team.
 
Moka.Care is a disability-friendly company.

About AQEMIA
 
AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 
About our Team
 
AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.

The role

AQEMIA's drug discovery programs and AI platform increasingly create value through licensing deals and strategic partnerships with pharma and biotech companies.

As our first in-house Legal Counsel, you will lead the legal work on these deals from term sheet to signing. You'll make sure each licensing agreement maximises value creation for Aqemia, protects our IP, and the platform behind every program. Beyond licensing, you will become the trusted legal partner for CEO, founders, leadership and teams across the company, covering IP and patents, operational contracts, data and AI, compliance and corporate matters alongside specialist external counsel. Within a year, you will have shaped how legal works at AQEMIA: issues will be mapped and anticipated, processes will be practical, and leadership will rely on you for well-judged legal advice. Reporting to the Corporate Finance Manager, you’ll have a rare chance to sit at the centre of the deals that bring AI-discovered drug candidates to partners, and to grow well beyond licensing into a broad in-house role.


Responsibilities
  • Licensing & partnerships: lead the legal work on licensing and collaboration deals, drafting and negotiating agreements from term sheet to signing.
  • Deal strategy: work with BD, Finance and Leadership to turn commercial goals into contract terms, while protecting AQEMIA's platform and other programs.
  • IP & patents: support IP protection and patent-related decisions with scientific teams and external patent counsel.
  • Operational contracts: draft and negotiate NDAs, MTAs, CRO, vendor, software and data agreements, including contractual questions on data use and AI.
  • Corporate & compliance: adresss GDPR, regulatory, compliance and dispute-related matters with specialist support where needed, and support corporate and fundraising matters in coordination with Finance and external advisors.
  • Legal processes: own templates and approval workflows, highlight key contract obligations and deadlines to relevant teams, and manage external counsel.

    • Qualifications
  • Law degree or equivalent professional legal qualification.
  • 5+ years of legal experience, including time at a law firm in a life sciences practice. In-house experience at a biotech or pharma company is a strong plus.
  • Licensing: hands-on experience drafting and negotiating biotech or pharma licensing agreements yourself, not only coordinating external counsel.
  • Deal knowledge: strong understanding of licensing mechanics and IP ownership in drug discovery (scope, exclusivity, financials, termination).
  • Communication: excellent English drafting and negotiation skills, and you can explain legal points clearly to non-lawyers.
  • Mindset: autonomous, pragmatic and eager to learn legal topics beyond your current expertise.

    • Nice‑to‑Have
  • In-house experience at a biotech, pharma or TechBio company, ideally a startup or lean legal team.
  • Exposure to AI, data or technology platform agreements (data rights, model training, ownership of outputs).
  • Experience building legal processes, templates or contract management from scratch.
  • Business development or commercial experience alongside your legal background.
  • Professional French.

    • Our recruitment process

    • 1 - Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager (45 mins)
    • 2 - Technical assessment of your skills through a Business Case (60 mins)
    • 3 - Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO Emmanuelle (45 mins)
    • 4 - Final interview with our co-founder and CEO Maximilien (45 mins)

    Why Join Us ?
     
    At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.
     
    Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline : Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal.
    World-Class Interdisciplinary Team : work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation.
    DeepTech Recognition: AQEMIA is proud to be part of the French Tech 40 and France 2030, highlighting our role as a key player in Europe’s DeepTech ecosystem.
    Prime Location with Flexibility : Our offices are located in the heart of Paris and London (King’s Cross), with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week.
    Strong Financial Backing : $100M raised from leading European and International investors

La rétention et la protection de nos comptes les plus stratégiques sont au cœur de notre capacité à défendre notre part de marché, et c'est vous que nous cherchons pour en prendre la tête.

Votre mission

À la tête de 3 Experts Rétention et 2 Key Account Managers, vous faites de la France la référence du groupe : une machine de rétention scalable et prévisible, et un Key Account Management qui devient le moteur d'expansion de nos comptes premium.

01 — Piloter la machine de rétention

Protéger le portefeuille et nos parts de marché.

  • Bon portefeuille & bon niveau de risque : cartographier le portefeuille France selon le risque réel de churn et arbitrer l'effort entre comptes volume et comptes premium.
  • Playbook vivant : arguments de rétention, gestion des objections, upsell et cross-sell, critères d'escalade clairs.
  • Signaux faibles : agir sur les comptes à risque avant la résiliation, pas en fin de mois.

02 — Structurer et faire grandir le Key Account Management

Faire de nos comptes les plus stratégiques un levier de croissance durable.

  • Bon périmètre & bons objectifs : salons à forte valeur ajoutée (pas nécessairement des chaînes) et partenaires stratégiques, avec des objectifs clairs de croissance.
  • QBR data-driven : des revues trimestrielles qui débouchent sur des plans d'action concrets : upsell (site web, Tap to Pay…), ouvertures, renouvellements, Treatwell Business Days.
  • Bons leviers de négociation : commissions, frais et contreparties par paliers de revenus, exceptions arbitrées avec Pricing / Revenue, et lead sur les négociations en escalade sans déposséder le KAM.

03 — Piloter par la donnée

Fabriquer le résultat par un rythme rigoureux et des chiffres fiables.

  • Centre de profit : obsession du taux de rétention, du churn, du NRR, de l'ARPU et de la TTV.
  • Forecast « no-surprise » : prévisions de churn et d'upsell, pilotage par les indicateurs avancés.
  • Tech stack : un CRM (Salesforce) sans friction et une donnée de qualité sur le churn et ses motifs.

04 — Manager une équipe de haute performance

Des standards sans compromis et une équipe qui grandit.

  • Leadership par l'exemple : mener depuis l'arène, avec une culture « No-Excuse » & « No-Asshole ».
  • Sales & Retention Academy : 1-to-1, revues d'appels et un onboarding qui amène chaque recrue à pleine productivité.
  • « High bar » & « One Team » : recruter haut, développer les hauts potentiels et travailler main dans la main avec Sales, Produit et Marketing.

Requirements

  • Expérience confirmée en management d'équipe, idéalement en environnement B2B, SaaS ou orienté client.
  • Expérience solide en rétention, Customer Success ou Key Account Management ; la double culture est un vrai plus.
  • Un(e) leader de terrain qui pilote par la donnée, avec un track record de structuration (process, playbooks, onboarding).
  • Français courant et aisance en anglais.

Benefits

  • Impact réel : un vrai mandat sur les comptes les plus stratégiques de Treatwell France.
  • Package : fixe 40-45K€ + variable indicatif 20K€.
  • Cadre de travail : Paris, hybride, 28 jours de congés, tickets restaurant, Gymlib, 40€/mois sur l'app Treatwell.

Egalité des chances

Treatwell est un employeur “Ouvert à tous” et accueille chaleureusement tout le monde dans son équipe. Nous nous engageons à apporter des aménagements raisonnables au processus de recrutement selon les besoins. Merci d’indiquer toute demande d’ajustement lors de votre candidature.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Join us as a Project Security Officer, where you’ll be the primary security interface for the Nyx project, connecting Mission Operations with central security functions, engineering teams, suppliers, and external partners. You’ll translate requirements into practical, verifiable controls across our mission systems, working hands-on with engineers, technicians, and operators from concept through operations. Applications at all seniority levels are considered.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact for security-related topics on the Nyx project.

  • Translate company policies, customer requirements, regulations, and threat intelligence into project-specific security requirements, architectures, procedures, and verification criteria.

  • Maintain the integrated project security risk picture across cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture domains.

  • Flow security requirements into systems, subsystems, suppliers, and operations, and verify their implementation with objective evidence.

  • Work hands-on with engineers and the security team to implement secure configurations, access controls, segmentation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and other cybersecurity controls.

  • Support threat modelling, risk assessments, security-by-design, system reviews, supplier assessments, security readiness, and assurance activities throughout the project lifecycle.

What we would love to see from you:

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity engineering, systems security, infrastructure security, operational technology, embedded security, project security, or a related hands-on field.

  • Experience working across multiple technical domains, such as networks, operating systems, applications, communications, embedded systems, hardware, or data centers.

  • Experience translating security requirements, policies, regulations, or customer expectations into system designs, technical controls, configurations, tests, procedures, and objective evidence.

  • Experience in security risk management, including risk-based vulnerability prioritization, threat and risk analysis, security testing, incident response, supplier and supply-chain security, and secure system integration.

  • Practical experience configuring, hardening, troubleshooting, or monitoring real systems—not only reviewing designs or producing documentation.

  • Ability to integrate cyber, physical, personnel, supply-chain, export-control, and security-architecture considerations into a coherent project-security approach.

  • Strong communication, organization, project-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build trust across Corporate IT, engineering, suppliers, central security functions, and Mission Operations.

 

Bonus qualifications:

  • Experience working with operators in control rooms, mission-control environments, NOCs, SOCs, launch campaigns, test operations, or other time-critical operational settings.

  • Experience securing spacecraft, launch systems, ground stations, mission-control centers, satellite communications, telemetry systems, or other complex control systems.

  • Experience integrating security into system design, supplier agreements, procurement, verification, acceptance, and operational readiness.

  • Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity, space, export-control, or customer frameworks, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, IEC 62443, ECSS, or applicable national requirements.

  • Relevant certifications or demonstrated experience with security tooling, automation, vulnerability assessment, monitoring, detection, or incident response.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance, and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Support team as the direct manager of a group of Support Engineers. While the function operates globally, with part of the team in Paris and the rest in New York, this specific role is based in Paris.

You will report to Matthieu, Global Head of Scale CS, and your manager, who will support you in achieving your goals. You will also partner closely with Support Operations, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, and IT. You will also be part of the global Go-To-Market community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As Support Team Lead, you will be the direct manager of our Support Engineers and accountable for the team's day-to-day performance, development, and service delivery. You will translate our Support strategy into effective routines, consistent execution, and an excellent customer experience.

This is a player-coach role. Your primary focus is managing and developing the team, but you'll stay close to operations, supporting complex investigations, reviewing ticket quality, and coordinating escalations when needed. The Head of Support defines the strategy and long-term evolution of the function. You make sure the team delivers on it every day.

We're looking for someone who is a natural people developer: accountable, structured, thorough, calm under pressure, data-informed, proactive, and collaborative. We strongly believe in growing our people internally, and this role is also a strong stepping stone toward broader Support and Customer Success leadership for those who want to keep growing.

People Management & Team Development

Directly manage, coach, and develop the Support Engineers to help them perform at their best and grow in their careers:

  • Hold regular one-to-ones, set clear expectations, and provide frequent, actionable feedback

  • Monitor individual performance, address issues when needed, and lead performance reviews and development plans

  • Identify skills gaps and organize coaching, training, and knowledge-sharing

  • Own onboarding and ramp-up for new team members, and participate in hiring

  • Foster a culture of customer empathy, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Daily Service Delivery & Escalation Management

Own the daily delivery of Support and act as the first point of management escalation for complex, urgent, or sensitive cases:

  • Monitor ticket queues, backlog, workload, and service levels, and ensure tickets are correctly prioritized and followed through

  • Organize team coverage (absences, shifts, peak periods) and step in when service delivery is at risk

  • Review and coordinate escalated tickets, defining next steps and involving the right internal stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success)

  • Coordinate customer communication on significant cases, and escalate major risks or executive concerns to the Head of Support

Quality, Process, & Performance

Maintain high standards of technical quality, and bring a critical, structured eye to how Support operates today, proposing and driving changes rather than simply preserving the status quo:

  • Identify where tickets could be resolved faster and more efficiently in writing, and reduce the number of cases that unnecessarily escalate into calls, especially multi-stakeholder ones, to protect everyone's time and improve the ROI of customer interactions

  • Review ticket quality using QA tools and scorecards, and coach the team based on the results

  • Ensure investigations are structured, well-documented, and clearly communicated to customers

  • Monitor operational and quality indicators (backlog, response/resolution time, CSAT, quality scores) to identify risks and drive corrective action

  • Document, monitor adoption of, and continuously improve Support workflows, in partnership with Support Operations

Cross-functional Collaboration

Make sure Support works effectively with the rest of the business.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on customer investigations and product issues

  • Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales on customer situations requiring Support involvement, and continuously refine which team owns which type of request across the client lifecycle

  • Clarify responsibilities and handovers between Support and other teams, and represent the team's operational needs in cross-functional discussions

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Zendesk (or an equivalent ticketing platform), our data stack tools, Microsoft Office, UpSlide, and internal knowledge-base tools (or local equivalents).

⚡Your goals

You will be assessed on:

  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Time to Resolution (TTR)

  • Ticket-to-active-user ratio

  • Team engagement and development


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Proven experience managing or leading a customer-facing team, ideally in B2B SaaS, technical support, or a similar operational environment

  • Strong coaching and people-development skills, including the ability to give clear, constructive, and sometimes difficult feedback

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities across a team

  • Experience using service or operational metrics to identify issues and improve performance

  • Strong customer communication and escalation-management skills

  • Ability to understand technical issues and guide structured investigations, without needing to personally own every ticket

  • Fluent in French & English mandatory

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams

  • A pragmatic, accountable approach to problem-solving, with a bias for ownership over escalation

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience directly managing a team of five or more people

  • Experience supporting Enterprise customers

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Office add-ins, deployment, or IT environments

  • Familiarity with Zendesk or a similar ticketing platform

  • Experience with quality and knowledge management, or Support Operations

  • Experience supporting distributed or international teams

  • Familiarity with automation, AI-assisted Support, or self-service strategies

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your management experience in Support.

  3. Case study and a team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 2-3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing.

  • Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel.

  • Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes.

  • Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes.

  • Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

  • Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

  • Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive.

  • Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…).

  • Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique.

  • Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

  • Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine).

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

  • Tu parles anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés.

  • Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires.

  • Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client.

  • Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence.

  • Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers…

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Entretien avec le manager.

  • Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif.

  • Entretien final avec la Direction.

Localisation : Aix-en-Provence, avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et 3 jours de télétravail.

Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable

data.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

At Quandela, we're moving from an R&D-driven organization toward a structured, scalable industrial operation. We're looking for a builder as much as a manager to create our end-to-end supply chain, from demand to customer delivery. Your first major challenge: build our S&OP process from the ground up. You'll move easily between strategy and execution, from running an S&OP review and an 18-month capacity outlook to solving a critical component shortage or securing an urgent customer shipment. 

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Build the S&OP process from scratch: define governance, meeting cadence, roles, inputs and KPIs, then progressively mature it as the company scales 
  • Lead monthly cross-functional S&OP reviews with Sales, Operations, Production, R&D, Purchasing, Finance and Management, and establish a single shared view of demand, supply and customer commitments
  • Consolidate demand from customer orders, weighted commercial forecasts, internal R&D needs, qualification activities and strategic programs into a rolling forecast
  • Build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, with planning horizons adapted to our long manufacturing and supply lead times
  • Translate demand into capacity, resource, material and supplier requirements, identify gaps and develop scenarios to support management decisions on priorities and commitments
  • Turn the production plan into executable schedules, monitor WIP and progress, and coordinate recovery plans when delays or shortages occur
  • Structure purchasing and MRP processes, define sourcing strategies based on lead time, criticality, supply risk, cost and MOQ, and track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness)
  • Define inventory principles and safety-stock strategies for critical components, while managing excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock
  • Organize inbound, internal and outbound logistics, including the transport of fragile, sensitive and high-value technological products
  • Manage customs and international trade: import/export documentation, classification, country of origin, Incoterms and compliance, in coordination with forwarders and brokers
  • Contribute to the selection and deployment of ERP/MRP and planning tools, reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and build clear supply chain dashboards
  • Define and track key KPIs (forecast accuracy, plan adherence, supplier and customer OTD/OTIF, inventory turns, shortages, lead times) and drive continuous improvement

Requirements

  • Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field 
  • 5+ years of experience in planning, supply chain or industrial operations
  • Proven experience implementing or running an S&OP process 
  • APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP)
  • Strong command of demand and production planning, scheduling, MRP, purchasing, inventory management and logistics 
  • Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to turn complex data into clear priorities and decisions
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills
  • Thrives in a fast-changing, growing organization
  • Fluent French and English 

 Nice to have 

  • Experience in semiconductor, photonics, electronics or other high-tech manufacturing
  • Foundries, outsourced manufacturing and long-lead-time, critical-component supply chains
  • International suppliers and customers, customs and international logistics
  • ERP implementation or supply chain digitalization; advanced Excel or Power BI 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

Deine Mission

Die collana health AG fungiert als digitales Kompetenzzentrum für das schweizerische Gesundheitswesen. Wir begleiten Spitäler, Kliniken und Gesundheitsinstitutionen in allen Phasen der Digitalisierung – von strategischer Beratung über Prozessoptimierung bis zur Implementierung und zum Betrieb von IT-Lösungen. Als Teil der collana Gruppe verbinden wir Branchenexpertise im Gesundheitswesen mit technologischem Know-how.
 
Unsere Mission: Komplexe Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen durch smarte, integrierte und nachhaltige digitale Lösungen zu entschärfen. Wir streben danach, Effizienz zu steigern, Prozesse zu harmonisieren und die Qualität der Versorgungsleistung zu verbessern, unter Einhaltung höchster Standards in Datenschutz und Interoperabilität.


Deine Aufgaben

Als Senior Consultant Health bist du eine Schlüsselperson in unserem Beratungsteam und agierst in folgenden Verantwortungsbereichen:

  • Projektleitung und Teilprojektleitung in Digitalisierungs- und IT-Transformationsprojekten im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategische und operative Beratung von Kunden (Spitäler, Kliniken, Pflegeinstitutionen etc.) entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette
  •  Anforderungsanalyse, Prozessdesign und Konzeption von IT-Lösungen (ERP, Schnittstellen, Systemintegration)
  • Begleitung und Steuerung der Einführung von Standardsoftware, insbesondere im ERP-Umfeld (z. B. Dynamics 365 Business Central)
  • Sicherstellung der technischen und fachlichen Qualität, inkl. Testmanagement, Change- und Betriebsüberführung
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung und Beteiligung an Akquisitionsaktivitäten
  • Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Fachseite, IT/Architektur, Entwicklung und Betrieb
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsportfolios und Mitwirkung an internen Innovationen
Oder
  • Führung von komplexen Transformationsprogrammen (klassisch oder agil) im Gesundheitswesen
  • Strategieberatung für Kunden – Entwicklung von Digitalisierungsstrategien mit Fokus auf Governance, Interoperabilität, Datenschutz und Effizienz
  • Analyse von Prozessen entlang der Patient Journey, Tarifsystemen, Abrechnungssystemen, Supply Chain im Gesundheitsbereich
  • Konzeption von modularen IT-Lösungen, E-Health-Szenarien, Systemintegrationen und Datenarchitekturen
  • Verantwortung für Pre-Sales, Angebotsentwicklung, Kundenworkshops und Stakeholder-Management
  • Steuerung der Umsetzung: Teil- oder Gesamtprojektleitung, Qualitätssicherung, Änderungsmanagement, Testbegleitung
  • Übergabe in Betrieb / Managed Services, Sicherstellung eines nachhaltigen Handovers
  • Mitwirkung in der Weiterentwicklung des Leistungsportfolios, Einführung neuer Services / Lösungen


Das bringst Du mit

  • Hochschulabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizininformatik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder vergleichbar)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Beratung oder Umsetzung von IT- bzw. Digitalisierungsprojekten, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen
  • Erfahrung in Prozessanalyse, Konzeption und Einführung von ERP-Systemen bzw. modularen IT-Lösungen
  • Vertrautheit mit Schnittstellen, IT-Architekturen und Integrationskonzepten
  • Idealerweise Kenntnisse von Standards und Technologien im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. HL7, FHIR, IHE)
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales, Angebotserstellung oder Akquise wünschenswert
  • Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen, pragmatische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Kundenorientierung und überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Selbstständige und vertrauenswürdige Arbeitsweise mit Verantwortungsübernahme
  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Teamarbeit und Innovationsprojekten
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (Italienisch und Französisch von Vorteil)


Warum wir?

  • Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen, wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Ein professionelles Umfeld mit spannenden Projekten im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen
  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Einbindung in strategische Themen
  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Zugang zu Innovationen und Austausch im collana IT Netzwerk
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, Teilzeitmodelle möglich
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit der Option auf hybrides Arbeiten
Rahmenbedingungen:
  • Arbeitspensum: 80-100%
  • Standort: Büro in Bern und Winterthur, Einsätze schweizweit
  • Eintrittstermin: nach Vereinbarung
Wenn dich die Aufgabe reizt, mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mit digitalen Lösungen mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns über deine vollständigen Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse).Für Fragen steht dir deine Recruiterin Julia ----- gerne zur Verfügung.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

  • Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

  • Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

  • Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

  • Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

About You

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

  • You can do 2 or more of the following:

  • Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

  • Develop and deploy NLP solutions

  • Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

  • Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

  • You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

  • You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

  • You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

  • You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

Compensation

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at

#LI-DNI

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne).
Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

  • Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages
  • Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics
  • Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites
  • Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage
  • Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants

Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements

Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne.

Formations recherchées :

  • Automaticien(ne) CFC
  • Mécatronicien(ne)
  • Électronicien(ne) CFC
  • Polymécanicien(ne) CFC
  • Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation
  • ou formation technique équivalente

Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante.


Compétences:

  • Bonnes connaissances en électronique, électricité et mécanique
  • Très bonne aisance informatique
  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques
  • Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique
  • Intérêt pour la robotique et les nouvelles technologies
  • Français courant et bonnes connaissances d’anglais technique
  • Allemand : un avantage
  • Permis de conduire catégorie B

Benefits

Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots.

Über uns

Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland.

Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden.

Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet.


Deine Rolle

Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld?

FormMed steht für hochwertige Mikronährstofflösungen, wissenschaftliche Qualität und das gemeinsame Ziel, Gesundheit nachhaltig zu verbessern. In einem respektvollen, lernbereiten Umfeld arbeiten wir täglich daran, medizinische Expertise zugänglich zu machen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Als Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) verantwortest du den strategischen und nachhaltigen Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebiets in der Westschweiz mit den Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und gewinnst neue Partner im Gesundheitswesen.

Du repräsentierst FormMed als kompetenten und verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte Vertriebsstärke mit Beratungskompetenz und einem echten Verständnis für die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden. Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt.

Wenn du Vertrieb mit Purpose verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und einen Markt nachhaltig entwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet in der Westschweiz und entwickelst dieses nachhaltig weiter.
  • Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis.
  • Du gewinnst neue FormMed-Therapeut und baust unser Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen gezielt aus.
  • Du bringst dein bestehendes Netzwerk aktiv in die Zusammenarbeit mit FormMed ein und entwickelst neue Kontakte zu langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Du betreust bestehende Kund systematisch weiter und entwickelst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften zu loyalen Key Accounts.
  • Du übernimmst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Gebiet und steuerst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent anhand relevanter KPIs.
  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung.
  • Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich.
  • Du konzipierst und begleitest individuelle Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kund passende Lösungen.
  • Du nutzt moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie Microsoft Dynamics CRM, digitale Vertriebstools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen, um deine Aktivitäten effizient zu planen und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen in der Westschweiz, leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab und setzt diese eigenverantwortlich um.
  • Du identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für deren Erschließung.
  • Du repräsentierst FormMed auf Fachveranstaltungen, Kongressen und relevanten Netzwerkveranstaltungen und stärkst damit unsere Präsenz im Schweizer Gesundheitsmarkt.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Kundenaufbau in deinem Vertriebsgebiet.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige, nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Umfeld.
  • Besonders willkommen sind Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mikronährstoffe, Diagnostik, Arzneimittel, Nahrungsergänzung oder vergleichbaren Gesundheitsprodukten.
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und zu Ärzten, Therapeuten, Apotheken oder weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, dein Netzwerk aktiv für den Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbeziehungen einzusetzen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln.
  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, medizinischen oder gesundheitlichen Bereich ist von Vorteil.

  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Vertriebskennzahlen, KPIs und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.
  • Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics, sowie MS Office und modernen digitalen Vertriebstools.
  • Du überzeugst durch ein professionelles Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie und kannst medizinische und vertriebliche Themen verständlich und auf Augenhöhe vermitteln.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind insbesondere für die Betreuung der Regionen Bern und Wallis von Vorteil.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit.
  • Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs.
  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit.


Warum wir?

  • Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag
  • Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Faire Arbeitszeiten & 25 Tage Urlaub – weil Work-Life-Balance für uns kein Buzzword ist
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen – z. B. auf unsere Präparate
  • Weiterentwicklung garantiert – fachlich wie persönlich, in internen Schulungen und externen Coachings
  • Ein Team, das dich trägt – regelmäßige Teamevents und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander inklusive


Wo soll ich mich melden?

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das Wissenschaft und Wirkung verbindet – mit Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und einem Arbeitsplatz, der inspiriert. Du möchtest mehr über FormMed und die Rahmenbedingungen erfahren? Dann ist Deine Ansprechpartnerin Tanja Seidemann (+49 160 / 94 16 18 07 ) aus dem People Team.

About Unblu

Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. We provide highly secure engagement and collaboration software, enabling financial institutions to enrich the digital experience of their clients.

By choosing a career with Unblu you choose to join an international, and innovation-savvy company. With our head office situated in Basel, Switzerland and additional offices in Bulgaria, Germany, the UK, Canada and the USA, you’ll be joining an international team dedicated to shaping the future of digital engagement. While Unblu is run as an independent company with global scope, we are fortunate to have Swiss Post as our anchor shareholder, providing long term support and vision to the company. 

The Role

As a Senior Account Executive, you are responsible for executing a strategic go-to-market approach and representing Unblu to customers, prospects, and partners. In addition, you are responsible for laying the foundation for rapid and sustainable growth of the customer base and revenues. This is primarily driven by your large and well established network in the financial sector and your refined skills in account-based selling within the B2B space. You will work closely with all functions across the company, selling both directly and indirectly to financial institutions, while driving new business with strategic accounts as well as upsell opportunities within our existing customer base.

This is a senior, quota-carrying role for someone who already has the relationships at CxO, Head of Digital, Head of Private Clients / Private Banking / Wealth Management level. The role requires regular travel across EMEA, with occasional travel to APAC  (expect 40–50% of your time on the road)

If you would like to be part of a growing and modern company, you are a team player and you appreciate the opportunity to contribute to the digital future of the financial services industry, then this role is for you! We are looking for the best in the industry and reward for performance. 

Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a sustainable and growing opportunity pipeline through account-based selling
  • Carry and deliver an individual annual quota, with full ownership of forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene
  • Drive the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closing, with a clear focus on new business in the EMEA region with a potential extension to APAC
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder RFP and tender processes in regulated environments
  • Review, manage, and escalate requests and issues to resolution. Act as an advocate within Unblu to ensure customer requests and issues are addressed in a timely manner
  • Represent Unblu at meetings, events and webinars
  • Own your accounts end to end, intimately understanding their business requirements, acting as a respected business partner
  • Identification of potential new partners within the ecosystem and support throughout the onboarding process

Requirements

  • Minimum 8 years in B2B SaaS / enterprise software sales
  • Minimum 5 of those years selling into banks and insurers
  • A documented track record of quota achievement
  • An active, referenceable network of decision-makers in financial institutions across EMEA
  • German at native-speaker level (C2) and English fluent (C1+), or vice versa, plus a third language at business level (B2+). All three are mandatory (any other language is a plus)

Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

  • Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

  • Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

  • Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

  • Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites.

Your Background

  • Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project.

  • Strong coding skills in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS 2.

  • Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged.

  • Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

  • Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo.

  • Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL).

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
